model: claude-opus-4-7 (drafted in chat — not via API)
notes: All 62 Life Skills text-input questions drafted as MCQ for head-of-ed review. Where the original stem was open-ended ('Tell me one X'), a `new_question` is provided to reframe as a single-answer MCQ; the merge script picks this up and updates the question text. Where no `new_question` is set, the original stem fits the MCQ format unchanged.

LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.08.stem: Sipho has a cold and is coughing. What is the kindest thing he can do to keep his friends safe?
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.08.ruby_prompt: Sipho is coughing because he has a cold. What is the kindest thing he can do?
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.08.memo: Coughing into your elbow stops germs from getting on your hands or your friends. It is a kind thing to do when you have a cold.
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.08.rationale: Elbow-cough is the kind, hygienic choice; the other two spread germs.

LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.stem: Tell me one good thing about yourself.
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.ruby_prompt: Everyone has a good thing about them. What is one good thing about you?
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.memo: Everyone has something good about them. Maybe you are kind, brave, helpful, funny, or good at running. Saying nice things about yourself is healthy.
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.original_expected: I am kind to my friends
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.new_question: Which of these is a kind thing to say about yourself?
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.new_ruby_prompt: Saying kind things about yourself is healthy. Which one of these is a kind thing to say?
options: I am kind to my friends
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.expected: I am kind to my friends
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.10.rationale: Reframed from open-ended self-description to MCQ contrasting healthy self-talk with arrogance.

LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.15.stem: Name one disease that you can catch from someone else.
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.15.ruby_prompt: Some sicknesses can spread from one person to another. Name one.
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.15.memo: Diseases like a cold, the flu, and chickenpox can spread from one person to another. We can stop them by washing hands and not sharing cups.
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.15.new_question: Which of these is a sickness you can catch from someone else?
LS.L1.BKH.T01::T01.15.rationale: A cold is catching; the other two are accidents/injuries, not diseases that spread.

LS.L1.BKH.T02::T02.10.stem: Tell me one rule in your classroom and why it matters.
LS.L1.BKH.T02::T02.10.ruby_prompt: Every classroom has rules. Tell me one rule and why it matters.
LS.L1.BKH.T02::T02.10.memo: Class rules help everyone learn safely. Saying why a rule matters shows you understand what it is for.
LS.L1.BKH.T02::T02.10.original_expected: Raise my hand to speak so the teacher can hear one person at a time.
LS.L1.BKH.T02::T02.10.new_question: Which of these is a good classroom rule that helps everyone learn?
options: Push to get to your seat
LS.L1.BKH.T02::T02.10.rationale: Reframed to a single-answer MCQ contrasting a real classroom rule with disruptive behaviours.

LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.10.stem: Name one person in your family.
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.10.ruby_prompt: Who is one person in your family?
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.10.memo: Family members can be parents, brothers, sisters, grandparents, aunties, uncles, or cousins. There is no wrong answer.
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.10.new_question: Which of these is usually a member of someone's family?
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.10.rationale: Reframed from open-ended naming to MCQ distinguishing family from professional/community helpers.

LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.15.stem: Why is it useful to know your home address?
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.15.ruby_prompt: Knowing your address is helpful. Why is it useful?
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.15.memo: Knowing your address means a trusted grown-up can help you home, or call for help to come to you, if you are ever lost.
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.15.original_expected: So that grown-ups can help me find my way home or send help if I am lost
options: So grown-ups can help me get home
So I can keep it a secret
So I can spell big words
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.15.expected: So grown-ups can help me get home
LS.L1.BKH.T03::T03.15.rationale: Safety reasoning is the correct frame; distractors are plausible-sounding but unrelated.

LS.L1.BKH.T04::T04.09.stem: Name one way you can travel to school.
LS.L1.BKH.T04::T04.09.ruby_prompt: How might a child travel to school?
LS.L1.BKH.T04::T04.09.memo: We travel to school by walking, taking a taxi, riding a bike, or going in a car or bus. All ways are fine as long as we are safe.
LS.L1.BKH.T04::T04.09.new_question: Which of these is a way many children travel to school?
LS.L1.BKH.T04::T04.09.rationale: Reframed to single-answer; walking is the everyday SA answer, distractors are not.

LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.06.stem: Name one traditional South African food.
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.06.ruby_prompt: South Africa has many traditional foods. Name one.
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.06.memo: Traditional South African foods include pap, samp, biltong, morogo, bunny chow and many more. Every family may have favourites.
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.06.new_question: Which of these is a traditional South African food?
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.06.rationale: Pap is iconic SA; pizza and sushi are foreign-origin foods.

LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.12.stem: Tell me one healthy food you like to eat.
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.12.ruby_prompt: Healthy foods help our bodies grow. Tell me one you enjoy.
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.12.memo: Healthy foods include fruit, vegetables, beans, fish, and whole grains. Everyone has a favourite — there is no wrong answer.
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.12.new_question: Which of these is a healthy food?
LS.L1.BKH.T05::T05.12.rationale: Apple is healthy; sweets and fizzy drinks are common unhealthy distractors kids recognise.

LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.09.stem: Name one difference between a pet and a farm animal.
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.09.ruby_prompt: Pets and farm animals are different. Tell me one difference.
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.09.memo: Pets live with us at home and we look after them as friends. Farm animals usually live on a farm and give us food, milk, eggs or wool.
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.09.original_expected: Pets live at home with people, farm animals live on a farm and give us food
options: Pets live at home, farm animals live on a farm
Pets are wild, farm animals are not
Pets give us milk, farm animals do not
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.09.expected: Pets live at home, farm animals live on a farm
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.09.rationale: Correct difference is where they live; distractors swap or invert the true facts.

LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.15.stem: Name one food or drink we get from animals.
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.15.ruby_prompt: Some foods and drinks come from animals. Name one.
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.15.memo: We get milk from cows, eggs from chickens, meat from many animals, and honey from bees. There are lots of right answers.
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.15.new_question: Which of these is a food or drink we get from animals?
LS.L1.BKH.T06::T06.15.rationale: Milk comes from cows; bread and rice come from plants.

LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.06.stem: Name one hero you have heard of.
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.06.ruby_prompt: Heroes are brave, kind people. Name one you have heard of.
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.06.memo: Heroes include leaders like Nelson Mandela, community helpers, family elders, and even teachers. Any kind, brave person counts.
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.06.new_question: Which of these is a famous South African hero?
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.06.rationale: Mandela is the canonical SA hero; distractors are fictional characters, not real heroes.

LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.12.stem: Tell me one brave or kind thing someone in your family or community has done.
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.12.ruby_prompt: Real heroes are around us. Tell me one brave or kind thing someone has done.
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.12.memo: Real-life heroes do things like helping a neighbour, looking after a sick relative, or standing up for someone. Any answer counts.
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.12.original_expected: My grandmother walked far to help a neighbour
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.12.new_question: Which of these is a brave or kind thing a real-life hero might do?
LS.L1.BKH.T07::T07.12.rationale: Reframed; correct option models real-life kindness, distractors model unkindness.

LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.09.stem: Tell me about a time someone in the community helped you.
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.09.ruby_prompt: Helpers in our community do kind things. Tell me about a time someone helped you.
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.09.memo: Any kind helper counts — a teacher, neighbour, scholar patrol, shopkeeper, anyone who was good to you.
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.09.original_expected: My teacher helped me when I was lost
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.09.new_question: Which of these is something a helpful person in your community might do for you?
options: Help me when I am lost
Tell me to ask someone else
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.09.expected: Help me when I am lost
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.09.rationale: Reframed to MCQ contrasting active helping with refusal.

LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.15.stem: Name one helper in your community.
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.15.ruby_prompt: Communities have many helpers. Name one.
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.15.memo: Helpers include teachers, nurses, doctors, police, firefighters, postal workers, shopkeepers, neighbours and many more.
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.15.new_question: Which of these is a helper in your community?
LS.L1.BKH.T08::T08.15.rationale: Teacher is a real local helper; distractors are distant/fictional.

LS.L1.BKH.T09::T09.10.topic_title: Familiar places (my village / town / city / neighbourhood)
LS.L1.BKH.T09::T09.10.stem: Tell me about one place near where you live.
LS.L1.BKH.T09::T09.10.ruby_prompt: Knowing the places near home helps us feel safe. Tell me about one.
LS.L1.BKH.T09::T09.10.memo: Any place counts — a park, shop, school, friend's house. Knowing your area helps you feel at home.
LS.L1.BKH.T09::T09.10.original_expected: There is a park near my house where I play
LS.L1.BKH.T09::T09.10.new_question: Which of these is a place often found near where people live?
LS.L1.BKH.T09::T09.10.rationale: Park is everyday; volcano/jungle distractors are far-away/fictional in most SA contexts.

LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.06.stem: Tell me one thing your grandparents did differently from you.
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.06.ruby_prompt: Life has changed a lot. Tell me one thing your grandparents did differently.
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.06.memo: Any answer works — perhaps they walked far to school, fetched water from a well, listened to the radio instead of TV, or wore different clothes.
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.06.original_expected: They walked a long way to school instead of taking a taxi
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.06.new_question: Which of these is something many grandparents did that we do less today?
options: Walked a long way to school
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.06.expected: Walked a long way to school
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.06.rationale: Reframed to contrast then-and-now reliably across SA families.

LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.15.stem: Name one healthy thing you can do every day to stay fit.
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.15.ruby_prompt: Staying fit keeps us healthy. Name one healthy thing you can do every day.
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.15.memo: Walking, running, dancing, playing sports, doing chores — anything that moves your body counts.
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.15.new_question: Which of these is a healthy daily habit?
LS.L1.BKH.T10::T10.15.rationale: Walking is healthy; the others are clear unhealthy contrasts.

LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.07.stem: What does it mean to be a good friend?
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.07.ruby_prompt: Friends matter. What does it mean to be a good friend?
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.07.memo: Good friends are kind, honest, share, listen, and stand up for each other. There are many right answers.
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.07.original_expected: To be kind, to listen, and to help when my friend needs me
options: Be kind and listen to my friend
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.07.expected: Be kind and listen to my friend
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.07.rationale: Correct option captures the core; distractors are clear negatives.

LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.13.stem: If someone is hurting you with their words or hands, who can you tell?
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.13.ruby_prompt: If someone hurts you, you don't have to keep it inside. Who can you tell?
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.13.memo: You can tell a parent, teacher, school nurse, or any trusted grown-up. They will believe you and help. Some children also call ChildLine on 116 — that is free.
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.13.original_expected: A parent, a teacher, or another grown-up I trust
options: A parent or teacher I trust
Nobody — I should keep it a secret
The person who is hurting me
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.13.expected: A parent or teacher I trust
LS.L1.BKH.T11::T11.13.rationale: Safeguarding question — correct answer is critical; distractors are explicit anti-patterns to teach against.

LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.topic_title: Stories of different South African communities
LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.stem: Tell me one festival or celebration your family enjoys.
LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.ruby_prompt: Families have special celebrations. Tell me one your family enjoys.
LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.memo: Any answer is welcome — Christmas, Eid, Diwali, Heritage Day, birthdays, family weddings, ancestor ceremonies — all are valid celebrations.
LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.original_expected: Heritage Day with family braai and traditional clothes
LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.new_question: Which of these is a celebration many South African families enjoy?
options: Heritage Day with a family braai
LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.expected: Heritage Day with a family braai
LS.L1.BKH.T12::T12.12.rationale: Reframed; distractors are non-celebrations to make the correct answer clear.

LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.11.stem: Tell me one thing you like about your own home.
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.11.ruby_prompt: Home is a special place. Tell me one thing you like about yours.
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.11.memo: Anything counts — the people, a bedroom, the kitchen smells, the garden, the safety. Home is a personal place.
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.11.original_expected: I like that my family is there
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.11.new_question: Which of these is something many people love about their home?
options: A leaky roof when it rains
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.11.rationale: Reframed; family is the universal answer, distractors are obvious downsides.

LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.15.stem: Name one type of home you have seen or heard about.
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.15.ruby_prompt: People live in many kinds of homes. Name one you have seen or heard about.
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.15.memo: Houses, flats, RDP houses, farmhouses, huts, caravans — any home counts. Different homes suit different families.
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.15.original_expected: A flat in a block of flats
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.15.new_question: Which of these is a type of home people live in?
options: A flat in a block of flats
A balloon up in the air
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.15.expected: A flat in a block of flats
LS.L2.BKH.T01::T01.15.rationale: Real home vs vehicles people don't normally live in.

LS.L2.BKH.T02::T02.10.stem: Name one way you can save water at home.
LS.L2.BKH.T02::T02.10.ruby_prompt: Water is precious. Name one way you can save it at home.
LS.L2.BKH.T02::T02.10.memo: Saving water means turning off taps when not in use, taking shorter showers, fixing leaks, and reusing water for plants.
LS.L2.BKH.T02::T02.10.original_expected: Close the tap while brushing my teeth
LS.L2.BKH.T02::T02.10.new_question: Which of these saves water at home?
options: Close the tap while brushing teeth
Leave the tap running while away
LS.L2.BKH.T02::T02.10.expected: Close the tap while brushing teeth
LS.L2.BKH.T02::T02.10.rationale: Common SA water-saving habit vs three water-wasting habits.

LS.L2.BKH.T03::T03.11.stem: Tell me one thing you like about your favourite season.
LS.L2.BKH.T03::T03.11.ruby_prompt: Each season has nice things. Tell me one thing you like about your favourite.
LS.L2.BKH.T03::T03.11.memo: Any answer works — beach in summer, warm fires in winter, flowers in spring, falling leaves in autumn.
LS.L2.BKH.T03::T03.11.original_expected: I love summer because we can swim
LS.L2.BKH.T03::T03.11.new_question: Which of these is something to enjoy about a South African summer?
LS.L2.BKH.T03::T03.11.rationale: This is the question that triggered the user's bug report — reframed to a clear seasonal-knowledge MCQ that the original 'warm weather' answer would now be the correct ballpark for (summer = beach).

LS.L2.BKH.T04::T04.11.stem: Tell me one thing you can do to look after your body.
LS.L2.BKH.T04::T04.11.ruby_prompt: Our bodies need care. Tell me one thing you do to look after yours.
LS.L2.BKH.T04::T04.11.memo: Anything caring counts — eating well, sleeping enough, washing, exercising, wearing seatbelts, brushing teeth.
LS.L2.BKH.T04::T04.11.new_question: Which of these helps you look after your body?
LS.L2.BKH.T04::T04.11.rationale: Hand-washing is a clear health habit; distractors are common unhealthy choices.

LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.10.stem: Tell me about a meal your family loves.
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.10.ruby_prompt: Family meals are special. Tell me about one your family loves.
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.10.memo: Family meals are special. Sharing yours helps others learn about your home and culture.
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.10.original_expected: My family loves to braai chicken on Sunday
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.10.new_question: Which of these is a meal many South African families enjoy together?
options: A tin of cold beans alone
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.10.rationale: Sunday braai is a strong SA cultural answer; distractors are clearly not 'meals families enjoy'.

LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.15.stem: Name one food that is eaten in your home and tell me why your family likes it.
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.15.ruby_prompt: Family foods carry stories. Name one your family eats and say why.
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.15.memo: Family foods carry love and tradition. Whatever you share is the right answer.
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.15.original_expected: We eat samp and beans because my grandmother taught us
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.15.new_question: Which of these is a good reason a family eats the same special food often?
options: It is the only food in the shop
We don't know what else to eat
Nobody likes it but we must
LS.L2.BKH.T05::T05.15.rationale: Tradition is the warm answer; distractors are negative framings.

LS.L2.BKH.T06::T06.12.stem: Name one energy source you have heard of.
LS.L2.BKH.T06::T06.12.ruby_prompt: Energy makes things work. Name one source you have heard of.
LS.L2.BKH.T06::T06.12.memo: Electricity, petrol, diesel, paraffin, wood, gas, solar, and wind are all energy sources. Any one counts.
LS.L2.BKH.T06::T06.12.new_question: Which of these is a source of energy?
LS.L2.BKH.T06::T06.12.rationale: Electricity is the everyday SA energy source; distractors are everyday non-energy items.

LS.L2.BKH.T07::T07.10.stem: Tell me one wild animal you have seen or heard about.
LS.L2.BKH.T07::T07.10.ruby_prompt: South Africa has many wild animals. Tell me one.
LS.L2.BKH.T07::T07.10.memo: Any wild animal counts — lion, leopard, rhino, hippo, springbok, baboon, vulture. They are all part of South Africa's wildlife.
LS.L2.BKH.T07::T07.10.new_question: Which of these is a wild South African animal?
LS.L2.BKH.T07::T07.10.rationale: Lion is iconic SA wildlife; distractors are pets/small house animals.

LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.09.stem: What is a healthy way to share your feelings?
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.09.ruby_prompt: Feelings are important. What is a healthy way to share them?
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.09.memo: Talking to a trusted person, writing in a journal, or drawing can all help. There are many right answers — the main thing is not keeping feelings stuck inside.
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.09.rationale: Healthy expression vs three unhealthy outlets the question is meant to teach against.

LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.12.stem: Tell me one feeling you sometimes have at school.
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.12.ruby_prompt: School brings up lots of feelings. Tell me one you sometimes have.
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.12.memo: All feelings at school are okay — excited, nervous, proud, sad, bored. Naming a feeling is the first step to handling it.
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.12.original_expected: I feel happy when I see my friends
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.12.new_question: Which of these is a healthy thing to do with a strong feeling at school?
options: Talk to a teacher or friend about it
Keep it stuck inside all day
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.12.expected: Talk to a teacher or friend about it
LS.L2.BKH.T08::T08.12.rationale: Reframed from 'name a feeling' (any answer) to 'what to do with a feeling' (one correct, three clear anti-patterns).

LS.L2.BKH.T09::T09.10.stem: Name one way you can help keep your school clean.
LS.L2.BKH.T09::T09.10.ruby_prompt: A clean school is a nicer school. Name one way you can help.
LS.L2.BKH.T09::T09.10.memo: Many answers work — picking up litter, sweeping, using bins, not eating in the classroom, telling a teacher about mess.
LS.L2.BKH.T09::T09.10.original_expected: Pick up my own litter and put it in a bin
LS.L2.BKH.T09::T09.10.new_question: Which of these helps keep a school clean?
options: Put my litter in a bin
LS.L2.BKH.T09::T09.10.expected: Put my litter in a bin

LS.L2.BKH.T10::T10.09.topic_title: National symbols and the national anthem
LS.L2.BKH.T10::T10.09.stem: Tell me one South African public holiday you know.
LS.L2.BKH.T10::T10.09.ruby_prompt: South Africa has many public holidays. Tell me one you know.
LS.L2.BKH.T10::T10.09.memo: South African holidays include Heritage Day, Freedom Day, Workers' Day, Youth Day, Women's Day and others. Any one counts.
LS.L2.BKH.T10::T10.09.new_question: Which of these is a South African public holiday?
LS.L2.BKH.T10::T10.09.rationale: SA holiday vs three foreign (US/Irish/British) ones.

LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.10.stem: Tell me one job someone in your family does.
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.10.ruby_prompt: Family members work in many jobs. Tell me one.
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.10.memo: Family members work as teachers, nurses, drivers, cleaners, farmers, shopkeepers and more. All work is important.
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.10.new_question: Which of these is a real job a family member might do?

LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.15.stem: What job would you like to do when you grow up, and why?
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.15.ruby_prompt: When you grow up you can do many jobs. Which would you like, and why?
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.15.memo: Any job is welcome. Saying why helps you think about what you care about and what you might enjoy.
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.15.original_expected: I would like to be a teacher because I love helping people learn
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.15.new_question: Which of these is a good reason to choose a job when you grow up?
options: I want to help people learn
I want to be mean to others
I want to do nothing all day
I want to break other people's things
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.15.expected: I want to help people learn
LS.L2.BKH.T11::T11.15.rationale: Reframed from open-ended career choice to a single-answer values question.

LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.10.stem: Name one thing the sun helps us with on Earth.
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.10.ruby_prompt: The sun does a lot for us. Name one thing it helps us with.
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.10.memo: The sun gives light, warmth, helps plants grow, dries our washing, and powers solar panels. There are many right answers.
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.10.original_expected: The sun gives us light and warmth
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.10.new_question: Which of these does the sun help us with?
options: It gives us light and warmth
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.10.expected: It gives us light and warmth
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.10.rationale: Correct fact vs three clear inversions of the truth.

LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.15.stem: Tell me one thing you would like to know about space.
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.15.ruby_prompt: Space is full of mystery. What would you like to know about it?
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.15.memo: Curiosity is how astronauts and scientists start. Any wondering counts.
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.15.original_expected: How long it takes to fly to Mars
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.15.new_question: Which of these is a real question scientists study about space?
options: How long it takes to fly to Mars
Where the moon keeps its hat
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.15.expected: How long it takes to fly to Mars
LS.L2.BKH.T12::T12.15.rationale: Real scientific question vs three nonsensical 'questions'.

LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.11.topic_title: Clothes and the materials they are made from
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.11.stem: Tell me about an item of clothing that is special to you or your family.
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.11.ruby_prompt: Special clothes can carry stories. Tell me about one in your family.
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.11.memo: Family clothes often carry stories — weddings, traditions, gifts. Sharing them helps us understand each other.
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.11.new_question: Which of these is most likely to be a special item of clothing in a family?

LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.19.topic_title: Clothes and the materials they are made from
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.19.stem: Name one type of protective clothing and a worker who uses it.
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.19.ruby_prompt: Workers wear protective clothes for safety. Name one and the worker who uses it.
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.19.memo: Hard hats for builders, gloves for doctors, gowns and aprons for chefs, helmets for cyclists, life jackets for sailors — many right answers.
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.19.new_question: Which of these is a real worker and the protective clothing they wear?
LS.L3.BKH.T01::T01.19.rationale: Real protective-clothing pairing vs three mismatched ones.

LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.11.stem: Name one fruit or vegetable that grows in South Africa.
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.11.ruby_prompt: South African farms grow many foods. Name one fruit or vegetable that grows here.
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.11.memo: SA grows oranges, apples, peaches, grapes, avocados, mangoes, pumpkins, spinach, potatoes — many great answers.
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.11.original_expected: Oranges grown in the Eastern Cape
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.11.new_question: Which of these is a fruit or vegetable that grows in South Africa?
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.11.rationale: Real SA-grown fruit vs three impossible-where claims.

LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.19.stem: Tell me one food from South Africa and where it might be grown.
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.19.ruby_prompt: South African food often comes from a specific region. Tell me one food and where it grows.
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.19.memo: Examples: oranges in the Eastern Cape, apples in Ceres, sugar in KwaZulu-Natal, maize in the Free State. Many right answers.
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.19.original_expected: Oranges grow in the Eastern Cape
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.19.new_question: Which of these is true about food grown in South Africa?
options: Oranges grow in the Eastern Cape
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.19.expected: Oranges grow in the Eastern Cape
LS.L3.BKH.T02::T02.19.rationale: Real SA fact vs three impossible-where claims.

LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.10.stem: Name one endangered animal in South Africa.
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.10.ruby_prompt: Some animals in South Africa are endangered. Name one.
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.10.memo: Endangered SA animals include the black rhino, African wild dog, riverine rabbit, blue crane and many sea creatures. Any one is valid.
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.10.new_question: Which of these is an endangered animal in South Africa?
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.10.rationale: Endangered wild animal vs three common domestic ones.

LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.19.stem: Tell me one fact about a dinosaur or extinct animal you find interesting.
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.19.ruby_prompt: Dinosaurs were amazing. Tell me one fact you find interesting.
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.19.memo: Any real interest counts — sizes, food, where they lived. Curiosity is how scientists discover more.
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.19.original_expected: The T-rex had very small arms
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.19.new_question: Which of these is a true fact about T-Rex?
options: T-Rex lived deep in the ocean
T-Rex was as small as a mouse
LS.L3.BKH.T03::T03.19.rationale: Real T-Rex fact vs three clearly false ones.

LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.12.stem: Tell me about one way you talk to family members who live far away.
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.12.ruby_prompt: Even far-away family can stay close. Tell me one way you talk to them.
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.12.memo: Phone calls, WhatsApp, video calls, emails, letters — all are ways to keep in touch. Any answer counts.
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.12.original_expected: We call on the phone or send WhatsApp messages
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.12.new_question: Which of these is a real way to talk to family who live far away?
options: A loud shout from the gate
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.12.rationale: Real modern comms vs three impractical 'methods'.

LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.19.stem: Name one way you could share important news with your whole class today.
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.19.ruby_prompt: If you have news for everyone in the class, how could you share it?
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.19.memo: Many right answers — a poster, a class WhatsApp message via the teacher, an announcement, a song or play. Good communication finds the right tool.
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.19.original_expected: Make an announcement during morning circle
options: Make an announcement at morning circle
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.19.expected: Make an announcement at morning circle
LS.L3.BKH.T04::T04.19.rationale: Public sharing method vs three private/silent ones.

LS.L3.BKH.T05::T05.12.stem: Tell me one kind thing you could do for a friend who has lost someone they love.
LS.L3.BKH.T05::T05.12.ruby_prompt: Grief is hard. What is one kind thing you could do for a friend who has lost someone?
LS.L3.BKH.T05::T05.12.memo: Just being there matters. A hug, listening, a kind note, or sitting in silence — all are kind. You don't need fancy words.
LS.L3.BKH.T05::T05.12.original_expected: Sit with them and listen if they want to talk
options: Tell them to cheer up quickly
LS.L3.BKH.T05::T05.12.rationale: Compassionate presence vs three forms of avoidance/dismissal.

LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.10.stem: Tell me about one famous place in South Africa you would like to visit, and why.
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.10.ruby_prompt: South Africa has amazing places. Tell me one you would like to visit and why.
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.10.memo: Any answer counts — Cape Town, Kruger, Robben Island, the Drakensberg, a local landmark in your town. Saying why helps you think about what interests you.
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.10.original_expected: I would like to visit the Kruger Park to see elephants
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.10.new_question: Which of these is a famous place in South Africa?
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.10.rationale: Reframed from 'want to visit' to factual SA-vs-foreign.

LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.20.stem: Name a famous place near where you live and tell me one thing about it.
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.20.ruby_prompt: Famous local places matter too. Name one near you and say something about it.
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.20.memo: Any local landmark counts — a market, monument, church, park, sports stadium. Knowing your area builds a sense of belonging.
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.20.original_expected: Our local park is famous for its big old trees
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.20.new_question: Which of these is something a famous local place might be known for?
options: Big old trees in the park
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.20.expected: Big old trees in the park
LS.L3.BKH.T06::T06.20.rationale: Realistic landmark feature vs fanciful distractors.

LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.topic_title: Stories from key South African historical events
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.stem: Tell me one event from your own life that you remember well.
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.ruby_prompt: Your own life has important events too. Tell me one you remember well.
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.memo: Family events, school days, holidays, special birthdays — all are part of your personal history. Any answer counts.
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.original_expected: The day my baby sister was born
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.new_question: Which of these is an event many people remember well from their own life?
options: The day a baby sister was born
The day the sky turned green
The day all clocks stopped working
The day everyone lost their name
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.expected: The day a baby sister was born
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.13.rationale: Real life event vs three impossible ones.

LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.19.topic_title: Stories from key South African historical events
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.19.stem: Name one event in your family's history that is important to your family.
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.19.ruby_prompt: Families remember key events. Name one important to yours.
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.19.memo: Births, weddings, moves, achievements, hard times shared — every family has its key events. They make us who we are.
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.19.new_question: Which of these is the kind of event often important in a family's history?
options: When the milk ran out one day
When the curtain moved a little
When the lamp was switched on
LS.L3.BKH.T07::T07.19.rationale: Major life event vs trivial daily moments.

LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.10.stem: Name one way you and your family can reduce waste at home.
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.10.ruby_prompt: Reducing waste helps everyone. Name one way you can at home.
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.10.memo: Many ideas — reuse bottles, compost food scraps, buy fewer disposable items, take cloth bags shopping, fix instead of throw away. All count.
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.10.new_question: Which of these helps a family reduce waste at home?
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.10.rationale: Waste-reducing habit vs three waste-creating habits.

LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.19.stem: Tell me one thing your school could do to be more eco-friendly.
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.19.ruby_prompt: Schools can help the planet too. Tell me one eco-friendly thing your school could do.
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.19.memo: Many ideas count — recycling bins, a vegetable garden, planting trees, saving water in tank, walking days. The point is action.
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.19.original_expected: Start a vegetable garden using compost from food scraps
LS.L3.BKH.T08::T08.19.new_question: Which of these would make a school more eco-friendly?

LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.10.stem: Tell me about a time you experienced bad weather and what your family did.
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.10.ruby_prompt: Bad weather can be scary. Tell me about a time and what your family did.
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.10.memo: Storms, hail, heavy rain, even a power cut — sharing helps you remember that families and communities cope together.
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.10.original_expected: When a big storm came, we stayed inside and lit candles
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.10.new_question: Which of these is a safe thing to do during a big storm?
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.10.rationale: Reframed to a safety-knowledge MCQ — important because it teaches storm safety explicitly.

LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.19.stem: Name one way climate change might affect South Africa.
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.19.ruby_prompt: Climate change has real effects. Name one way it might affect South Africa.
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.19.memo: Possible answers — more droughts, more severe storms, hotter summers, fires, less water for farming. Many right answers.
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.19.new_question: Which of these is a real way climate change might affect South Africa?
LS.L3.BKH.T09::T09.19.rationale: Real climate-change impact vs three counter-factual reversals.

LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.topic_title: Stories of role models from different cultures
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.stem: Tell me about one role model in your life and why.
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.ruby_prompt: Role models shape who we want to be. Tell me about one and why.
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.memo: Any answer counts — parents, grandparents, teachers, coaches, community workers. The 'why' matters more than the name.
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.original_expected: My grandmother is my role model because she works hard and is always kind
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.new_question: Which of these is a good reason to admire someone as a role model?
options: They work hard and are kind
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.expected: They work hard and are kind
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.06.rationale: Reframed; good qualities vs three negative ones.

LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.19.topic_title: Stories of role models from different cultures
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.19.stem: Name one quality you would like to have when you grow up.
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.19.ruby_prompt: Growing up means becoming a certain kind of person. Name one quality you'd like.
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.19.memo: Kindness, courage, patience, honesty, generosity — any quality you admire counts. Notice what your role models teach you.
LS.L3.BKH.T10::T10.19.new_question: Which of these is a quality worth working towards as you grow up?

LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.03.topic_title: Understanding myself: my abilities, interests, rights and responsibilities
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.03.stem: Tell me one thing you are good at.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.03.ruby_prompt: Everyone has things they are good at. Tell me one of yours.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.03.memo: Anything counts — running, drawing, helping younger siblings, being a kind friend, building things. Naming what you do well is a healthy thing.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.03.new_question: Which of these is a healthy way to say what you are good at?
options: I am the best in the world
I never need to try at anything
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.03.rationale: Reframed to contrast humble self-knowledge with arrogance/false modesty.

LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.15.topic_title: Understanding myself: my abilities, interests, rights and responsibilities
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.15.stem: Tell me one interest of yours — something you enjoy doing.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.15.ruby_prompt: Interests make us who we are. Tell me one of yours.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.15.memo: Reading, sport, music, drawing, helping at home, playing with friends — any interest is valid. Knowing what you enjoy helps you grow.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.15.original_expected: I enjoy drawing pictures of animals
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.15.new_question: Which of these is a healthy interest for a child to enjoy?
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.15.rationale: Healthy hobby vs three harmful 'interests' — explicit anti-pattern teaching.

LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.20.topic_title: Understanding myself: my abilities, interests, rights and responsibilities
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.20.stem: Name one responsibility you take seriously and why.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.20.ruby_prompt: Responsibilities help us grow. Name one you take seriously.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.20.memo: Any responsibility counts — homework, helping at home, caring for a pet, being a good friend. Saying 'why' shows you understand its meaning.
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.20.original_expected: I take care of my younger sister after school because she needs me
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.20.new_question: Which of these is a responsibility a child can take seriously?
options: Going to a paying job every day
LS.L3.BKH.T11::T11.20.rationale: Age-appropriate responsibility vs three adult-only ones.

LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.09.stem: Tell me about one celebration your family has each year.
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.09.ruby_prompt: Yearly celebrations are special. Tell me about one your family has.
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.09.memo: Birthdays, weddings, religious days, Heritage Day, family reunions — every celebration counts. Sharing yours helps others learn about your culture.
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.09.original_expected: We celebrate Christmas with a big family lunch
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.09.new_question: Which of these is a celebration many families have every year?
options: A day with no one home
A day everyone goes to work
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.09.rationale: Real annual celebration vs three non-celebrations.

LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.17.stem: Name one festival, holiday, or celebration that is important to your family or culture.
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.17.ruby_prompt: Festivals and holidays carry meaning. Name one important to your family.
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.17.memo: Any answer matters — Christmas, Eid, Diwali, a birthday, a wedding, Heritage Day. Sharing makes us closer.
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.17.original_expected: We celebrate Eid with our extended family every year
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.17.new_question: Which of these is a real festival, holiday, or celebration?
LS.L3.BKH.T12::T12.17.rationale: Real religious/cultural festival vs three invented non-events.
